nodes.label: Lovable Project Platform
nodes.rationale: Project is hosted/edited through Lovable; edits in Lovable auto-commit to the repo and pushed local changes reflect back, so the repo and the Lovable workspace are two views of the same source. Deploy is Share -> Publish, custom domain via Project > Settings > Domains.

nodes.label: Frontend Tech Stack (Vite, TypeScript, React, shadcn-ui, Tailwind CSS)
Four-Phase Seed Against the New Schema
nodes.rationale: Loads catalogo, fictional login-blocked people, teams, leads, deals, CCA, SDR, daily, gamification, marketing and workspace. Records are idempotent so the command can be re-run safely.

nodes.label: npm run db:seed:remote
nodes.rationale: Runs psql inside Docker specifically so the password is never placed in the connection URI nor in terminal history; the password is prompted without being echoed.

nodes.label: npm run user:create (first real user bootstrap)
nodes.rationale: Reads VITE_SUPABASE_URL from .env and prompts (without echo) for the initial password and the service_role key, so the privileged key is used once at bootstrap and never persisted.

nodes.label: service_role Key Must Never Reach the Vite .env or the Browser
nodes.rationale: The key is copied from Supabase -> Project Settings -> API Keys at use time. Anything in a Vite .env is bundled into client code, so storing it there, committing it, or exposing it in the browser would hand full-privilege database access to any visitor.
